videos.name: Rough Seas on Royal Caribbean's Vision of the Seas
videos.description:
!!Subscribe for more content like this!!
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmTwsd2YTjS9xykmScB_SrA?sub_confirmation=1

While we are on a Royal Caribbean cruise on the Vision of the Seas, we ran into a little weather. I should say that the video makes this look worse than it was, I was having a blast during all this and the crew was amazing. Very professional helping keep everyone safe. I just wanted to share a little of the video I captured during the rough waves.

videos.name: A Tour around Key West, Florida
videos.description: This is just a quick video of us looking around Key West, Florida when we were in port. We did not do an excursion just spent some time driving around town. It is definitely a place I want to visit again!

videos.name: Tour Nassau, Bahamas
videos.description: This is a short video of our trip around Nassau, Bahamas. We were in port on a Royal Caribbean Cruise and spent some time touring around town. Our cruise ship was the Vision of the Seas. I hope you enjoy our little trip around Nassau.

hero.alt: Quantum of the Seas in Juneau, Alaska, with floatplanes on the water
hero.eyebrow: CRUISE DAYS. SHORE STORIES. A LIFE TOGETHER.
heading: More ocean.
More memories.
Always together.
hero.description: Twenty years together, at least ten more cruises since our first, and so many memories still to make.

upcoming.title: Alaska
upcoming.imageAlt: Quantum of the Seas photographed in Juneau, Alaska
upcoming.intro: We’re heading north for a new chapter: seven days cruising Alaska aboard Quantum of the Seas.
notes: Our next cruise departs May 17, 2027. This is where we’ll share the planning, the sailing, and the memories that come home with us.
For now, the ship, departure date, and seven-day duration are set. We’ll add our ports and excursion plans as we get closer to sailing.

destinations.name: Nassau
destinations.sub: Beyond the port, a different side of the island.
destinations.text: On our first cruise, we headed beyond the port and markets to explore Nassau. One of our favorite sights was the Queen’s Staircase in the Fort Fincastle Historic Complex.

destinations.name: Key West
destinations.sub: A little wandering. A lot to come back for.
destinations.text: We loved walking around Key West and seeing the sights. We stopped for lunch at Sloppy Joe’s Bar, and left wanting more time to explore. This is a place we would love to visit again.

destinations.name: CocoCay
destinations.sub: Clear water. Slow days. Nowhere else to be.
destinations.text: Our favorite stop on the trip was Royal Caribbean’s private island, called Cocoa Cay in our original journal. We spent the day relaxing on a beach bed, snorkeling in clear water, and enjoying lunch delivered to our cabana bed.

stories.subtitle: A whole new horizon.
stories.label: From the archives / Our 13th anniversary

stories.summary: Our 13th anniversary, our first cruise, and the journey that started it all.
stories.context: This story remembers our 13th anniversary and our very first cruise. We’ve since celebrated our 20th anniversary and taken at least ten more cruises. We’re keeping this opening chapter just as we remember it.
